_comment: Harness configuration file. Fill in the values marked with TODO. Remove _comment fields before production use.

harness.name: TODO: Your harness name (e.g., 'design-review-agent')
harness.description: TODO: One sentence describing what this harness does
harness.author: TODO: Your name or team

model._comment: Choose the model that fits your use case. Sonnet = smart + capable. Haiku = fast + cheap. Opus = most powerful.
model._temperature_note: Lower = more consistent/predictable. Higher = more creative/varied. 0.3 is a good default for task agents.

context._max_context_note: Claude Sonnet supports 200k. Reserve headroom for tool outputs and conversation history.

tools._comment: List tool definition files to load. Each file in tools/ defines one tool.
require_confirmation_for: _comment: List tool names that require user confirmation before executing
TODO: add tool names here, e.g., 'write_file', 'send_notification'

hooks._comment: Hooks run automatically — the model can't skip them. Add hooks for things that must ALWAYS happen.

memory._session_memory_note: Agent remembers context within a single conversation session
memory._persistent_memory_note: Set to true if you want memory to persist across sessions (requires storage setup)

permissions._comment: Define what the agent is and isn't allowed to do. These are enforced by the harness, not the model.
allowed_directories: TODO: List directories the agent can read/write, e.g., './output', './data'
allowed_external_services: TODO: List external APIs the agent can call, e.g., 'api.figma.com'
blocked_actions: TODO: List actions the agent must never take, e.g., 'delete_file', 'send_email'

ui._comment: How the agent presents itself to users
ui._show_tool_calls_note: Show users when the agent is using a tool. Builds trust. Disable for simpler UX.
ui.error_message: Something went wrong. Here's what I know: {error}

workshop._comment: Remove this section before production use
